title: Haven Protocol
note: The team announced the closure after an exploit minted about 1.3 billion illicit XHV through at least 42 transactions; attackers ended up holding over 94% of the known supply.

title: BLOC.MONEY
note: The team published "BLOC Project - The end" and told holders to back up their private keys; the bloc.money domain now serves an unrelated site.

title: Saronite
note: Saronite and Purk merged their communities into XtendCash (XTNC), which is in this file as well; the Saronite chain stopped and saronite.io now serves an unrelated site.

title: Niobio Cash
note: The proof-of-work network was shut down in 2024 and lost its developers; the 2025 community revival, Niobio Cash Classic, runs on proof of stake, so the coin can no longer be mined.

title: XtendCash
note: The Saronite and Purk merger, later hard forked from cn-turtle to cuckaroo29s at block 105000; the code has not moved since September 2019, network hashrate, pools and markets are all at zero and xtendcash.com was resold.

title: BitGrin
note: A single block minted 5 billion XBG against the stated 21M cap, which the developer called a bug and others called a scam; the last release is from February 2020 and bitgrin.io no longer resolves.

title: MoneroV
note: The developers who held the repository, the site and the social accounts walked away; the last commit is from May 2019, monerov.org and monerov.online no longer respond and the markets are dead.
